name: Inkling Small
short: Thinking Machines' open-weight 276B/12B hybrid-reasoning model with text/image/audio in for coding/agents; SWE-bench 82.2%, 1M claimed/256K served.
modalities: Text in/out; image and audio input
standout: Thinking Machines’ hybrid-reasoning debut: it decides when to deliberate, and takes text, image and audio in from an open-weight base.
tradeoff: The served context is a fraction of the claimed window, and a young ecosystem means fewer deployment rails than the established open families.
